newsitem.title: USA: Destron Fearing sued over patents.
newsitem.headline: Destron Fearing sued over patents.

text.p: InfoPet Identification Systems, a division of TraceNET Technologies Inc, said a suit was filed against Destron Fearing Corp, alleging patent infringement, breach of contract and unfair competition.

InfoPet said the suit was filed by Trovan Ltd, Electronic Identification Devices Ltd, Algernon Promotions Inc and TraceNET. The suit named Destron-Fearing and Schering-Plough Corp, its distributor, as defendants.
In a statement, Destron-Fearing said the lawsuit filed by its competitors is completely without merit.

"We have not been served with the suit, nor have we seen a copy of the TraceNET filing," Randolph Geissler, president of Destron-Fearing, said in a statement. "However, based on the description in their news release, this suit makes the same claims as an earlier action which was withdrawn by the plaintiffs in January."

The plaintiffs said the complaint alleges that Destron-Fearing scanners distributed in the United States by Schering-Plough as part of its HOME AGAIN pet identification infringes Algernon's patent, which were assigned to it by Trovan.
